title: 2008 HMMT February General Round 2 Problem 10
statement: Determine the number of 8-tuples of nonnegative integers ( \(a_{1}, a_{2}, a_{3}, a_{4}, b_{1}, b_{2}, b_{3}, b_{4}\) ) satisfying \(0 \leq\) \(a_{k} \leq k\), for each \(k=1,2,3,4\), and \(a_{1}+a_{2}+a_{3}+a_{4}+2 b_{1}+3 b_{2}+4 b_{3}+5 b_{4}=19\).
